sources.name: Caves
sources.about: Natural caves on Aberdeen, Daymar, Hurston and moons in Stanton and Pyro. Caves aren't on the starmap — find their entrances on the surface.

sources.name: Occupied caves
sources.about: Caves with NPCs living or working in them (acidic, rock and sand caves in Stanton and Pyro).

harvestable_mineral_1h_carinitepure.w: Main source: mining. A rare spawn in the caves the Hathor orbital laser opens on Aberdeen and Daymar (Align & Mine). No loot table names it; it only qualifies for the generic gem and mineral crates below because the game tags it exactly like ordinary Carinite. Not confirmed in loot, and no chance can be worked out: expect it far less often than Carinite, if at all.
